pythonFunction.name: trigger_password_reset
pythonFunction.description:
Emails a password or PIN reset link to the email on file. The link is never read aloud or shown;
only confirm that it was sent. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, email_hint (masked) and link_validity_minutes.
